about: Recorded SFX prompts for tools/lyria_sfx.js (Lyria via the Gemini API). One entry per id of R.Audio.IDS.sfx. prompt / alt: the English text sent to Lyria (alt is used when the prompt is blocked, and on the second round). role: what the sound is for (also what the listener model judges against). target/minLen/maxLen: event length in seconds. merge: events closer than this (s) are one sound. variants: how many distinct takes to keep. peak: normalisation target in dBFS (= the synthesised sound's measured peak, so files and synth sit at the same level; header targets UI ≈ -12, spells -9…-6, impacts ≈ -3). rmsMax: loudness cap (dBFS RMS over the sound) = synth RMS + 4 dB, for sounds denser than their synth version. stereo: keep stereo. synth: measured synth reference (peak, rms dBFS, audible s). keepSynth: true → the game keeps the synthesised sound (files are only for audition).
